instruction.text: Setze den Text zusammen, indem du die jeweils richtigen Satzenden auswählst.

atoms.a: Yesterday, my Mom and I were at the supermarket
atoms.b: because we needed food for dinner.
atoms.sound: Yesterday, my Mom and I were at the supermarket because we needed food for dinner.

atoms.a: At first, I wanted to eat pasta
atoms.b: but then I thought fish and chips were better.
atoms.sound: At first, I wanted to eat pasta, but then I thought fish and chips were better.

atoms.a: My mother was looking for some potatoes
atoms.b: while I searched for the best fish.
atoms.sound: My mother was looking for some potatoes while I searched for the best fish.

atoms.a: We both went to the checkout to pay
atoms.b: as soon as we found everything.
